summary.tldr: Reduces the lowest personal income tax rate, adds a temporary GST new housing rebate for first-time buyers, removes the federal fuel charge, and changes some election privacy rules.
what_it_does: Lowers the marginal personal income tax rate on the lowest tax bracket to 14.5% for the 2025 tax year and 14% for 2026 and later tax years.
Creates a temporary GST new housing rebate for first-time home buyers under the Excise Tax Act and related regulations.
Repeals Part 1 of the Greenhouse Gas Pollution Pricing Act and the Fuel Charge Regulations.
Changes the Canada Elections Act rules for political parties’ policies on protecting personal information.
who_it_affects: Canadians subject to the fuel charge
summary.background: Bill C-4 was introduced in the House of Commons on 5 June 2025. It has four parts that change tax, housing, fuel charge, and election rules.
